Frequently Asked Questions

Who needs to pay estimated quarterly taxes?

Generally, you must pay estimated quarterly taxes if you expect to owe at least $1,000 in tax for the current year after subtracting your withholding and refundable credits.

What happens if I miss a quarterly estimated tax payment?

You may owe a penalty for underpayment of estimated tax. The penalty is calculated based on the amount underpaid, the period it was underpaid, and the interest rate for underpayments set quarterly by the IRS.
